position: A cancellation proof must exist before a real invitation path can be trusted
headline: The dry-run request receives an immutable cancellation receipt while every live system remains untouched.
copy: The receipt proves which request would be cancelled, why, by whom, and when. Since no invitation or token exists, the output records no provider mutation and no participant notification.

postures.title: Receipt evaluator
postures.copy: Safe and unsafe cancellation fixtures are covered.

postures.title: Dry-run linkage
postures.copy: The receipt requires a valid sixty-four-character request digest.

postures.title: Live token
postures.copy: Tokenized or in-use states are rejected.

postures.title: Provider mutation
postures.copy: No external revocation call is performed.

flow.title: Reference
flow.copy: Use the validated invitation request digest.

flow.title: Sign
flow.copy: Record a named owner and ordered timestamp.

flow.title: Verify
flow.copy: Hash the receipt and preserve zero side effects.

decisions.label: Receipt contract
decisions.reason: The result is deterministic and traceable.

decisions.label: Allowed reasons
decisions.reason: Consent, founder, readiness, and security reasons are explicit.

decisions.label: Provider calls
decisions.reason: No live invitation exists to revoke.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Only pseudonymous identifiers are accepted; direct identity is rejected.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: No token, email, delivery, or live invitation is created.

locks.title: Participant lock
locks.copy: No participant account or real session exists.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No external provider, notification, or durable participant write is touched.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private validation cannot open public access.
